title: Waterspout in the dark: how do you survive?

shots.title: Flash-forward: gripping the wheel, funnel behind
Beside your boat: the spout fills frame right
Minutes earlier: alone in the Triangle
Crane down into the cockpit: nodding at the helm
Flight 19 across the moon
Threat reveal: the spiral he can't see
Lightning: he sees it
Past the mast: the column rises
Taller than your mast
The tornado kind: base under the cloud wall
Worse: his face knows it
Instinct: key and throttle
And run: stern squats, wake opens
Channel sixteen
Help is hours away: empty horizon
High reveal: the spout slides down the wake
Over the shoulder: right down your wake
Five stages: gaze drops from cloud to water
Hold: watch the water
Midpoint: lightning strobes the full funnel, crane rise to a tiny boat
Stage three: the spray ring
Stage four is full strength: fear lands on his face
It's closing: the spout looms past the stern
Can't wait for stage five
Step one: the hand drifts closer, then stops
Holding away: as dangerous as tornadoes
Step two: tracking the ring
POV: the ring shows its path
Stage four: whip into the mature vortex
The ring swings toward the bow
Worse, it's gaining
Hold: step three saves you
Step three: compass, helm hard over (low angle)
Pullback: broadside to the spout's track
It tears past the stern
Not running saved you: the exhale
Never cursed: pulling back from Theo
Sting: the spout recedes under the moon
